text:
dalia: Quick sync: we discovered ~0.03% billing_key collisions in EU -> NA cross-region traces when using the legacy murmur64 mapping. Need decision: change hashing (sha256 truncated) or add namespace + check to avoid mis-billing.
raj: How are collisions detected?
dalia: From our reconciliation job: two different tenant_ids ended up with same billing_key in 6k traces over 20M. That caused ~1.5% discrepancy in a handful of accounts.
leigh: 0.03% seems small but impacts high-volume tenants. Also collisions are non-deterministic across languages/stable libs.
raj: Options: 1) switch to sha256(trunc128) canonical key, 2) keep murmur + add tenant namespace prefix, or 3) dual-write legacy & canonical and reconcile on read. Tradeoffs?
dalia: 1) sha256: simple, cross-language stable, cryptographic but bigger. Needs storage change for billing_key length. 2) namespace prefix: quick fix but brittle if edge misconfigures namespace. 3) dual-write: safest but doubles index space and increases write QPS for ingest.
leigh: Also think about queries and billing joins: we join by billing_key in the cost pipeline. If we change key shape we must migrate historical data or keep a mapping table with TTL. Backfills are painful.
raj: Can we do an opt-in rollout: emit canonical_key alongside legacy_key; cost pipeline tries canonical first then falls back to legacy. Over time we backfill mapping for high-volume tenants and eventually flip default.
dalia: That seems pragmatic. Implementation notes: edge/SDK must start emitting canonical_key by next deploy. Ingest must accept both keys and prefer canonical when present. Cost-aggregator needs a small mapping cache with writes from canonicalizer.
leigh: Cache design: LRU with TTL 30d, persistent hits persisted to mapping-store. Need idempotent writes. Also a safety check to detect divergent mapping (same canonical -> multiple tenants) and alert.
raj: What about storage size increase? If canonical is 32B vs legacy 8B, estimate index growth ~12%. Needs finance tie-in.
dalia: I ran numbers: index growth estimate 9-15% depending on compaction. Cost delta ~7% monthly storage. Our cost-savings from fixing mis-billing > expected impact for top 100 tenants, so OK.
leigh: Migration plan proposal:
- Phase A: deploy SDK + edge emit canonical_key (dual-write) to canaries (2 regions). Ingest accepts both fields. (owner: raj)
- Phase B: cost-aggregator reads canonical_key if present; otherwise lookup mapping table -> legacy_key fallback. Run both calculations for 7 days and emit discrepancy metric. (owner: dalia)
- Phase C: run backfill for top 1k tenants: generate mappings from historical traces and seed mapping-store. (owner: leigh)
- Phase D: after 30d stable with mismatch <0.1%, flip to canonical as primary and deprecate legacy.
raj: Add safe-guard: if mapping_store misses and lookup returns null, tag cost event as provisional and route to reconciliation queue (no billing until resolved).
leigh: Also need a small migration SQL to build mapping from history. Pseudo: 
```sql
INSERT INTO mapping_store (canonical_key, legacy_key, tenant_id)
SELECT trunc_digest('sha256', concat(tenant_id, '|', region)) as canonical_key,
       legacy_billing_key,
       tenant_id
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY canonical_key, legacy_billing_key, tenant_id
HAVING count(*) > 10;
```
dalia: Nice. Ops alerts to create:
- mapping_conflict_alert: canonical_key -> >1 distinct tenant_id in 1h window
- reconciliation_queue_length > 0 for >10m
- canonical_emit_coverage < 80% across edge regions
raj: SLOs: canonical_emit_coverage >= 95% after 14 days; attribution_mismatch_rate < 0.1% before flip.
leigh: Backfill considerations: do staged backfills by tenant shard to avoid big reads. Use existing backfill-worker with concurrency limit. Keep samples anonymized.
dalia: Privacy: canonical_key derived deterministically from tenant_id+region; ensure tenant_id is internal opaque id, not PII. Edge SDK must not derive from email or customer-visible id.
raj: I'll draft a short spec for SDK change and include canonical_key shape (hex-encoded 128-bit trunc of sha256).
ops-bot: Scheduled job: mapping-backfill-prepare queued at 1789991250 for job-runner-2. See https://ci.redwood/jobs/12421
leigh: Owners and next steps: raj -> SDK + edge emit PR; dalia -> cost-aggregator change + metrics; leigh -> mapping_store schema + backfill plan; ops -> set alerts and run canary.
dalia: Let's reconvene after canary run (48h) to assess discrepancy metrics. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
raj: I'll open the SDK PR today and tag reviewers.
leigh: +1
